label: Systematized Augustinian principle of faith seeking understanding (fides quaerens intellectum)
description: Anselm of Canterbury adopted Augustine of Hippo's insights and systematically extended them into new metaphysical, ethical, or epistemological domains.
dialecticalTension: Negotiating the intellectual shift from Augustine of Hippo's perspective to Anselm of Canterbury's reconstructed system.
historicalContext: Direct contemporaneous dialogue and pedagogical transmission during the Medieval & Islamic Golden Age era.
